headers.//: The service worker must never be cached, or a deploy cannot reach installed clients. Vercel's default for static files is already 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' — stated explicitly so a future default change cannot silently pin the fleet to an old worker. Service-Worker-Allowed lets the worker claim the whole origin.
Content-Type is stated because the manifest is served from the filesystem and some hosts guess text/plain for .webmanifest, which makes Chrome ignore it and silently blocks installability.
